clauses.quote: School will offer varied and nutritious food choices that are consistent with the federal government's Dietary Guidelines for Americans.
clauses.notes: Policy directive requiring management to provide nutrition-compliant food options.

clauses.quote: The superintendent or designee will establish measures to evaluate the compliance and implementation of the wellness policy and activities.
clauses.notes: Administrative duty imposed on district leadership.

clauses.quote: Equal educational opportunit~es for all students shall be provided by the Board without regard to sex, race, national origin, religion, economic, social or handicappinqconditions.
clauses.subject_text: Equal educational opportunit~es for all students
clauses.notes: Passive construction; implicit agent is the Board. Benefits students (mapped to worker per binary constraint). OCR artifacts retained verbatim.

clauses.quote: Students who live two or more miles from the school to which they have been assigned by the Board of Education will be provided school bus service.
clauses.subject_text: Students who live two or more miles from the school to which they have been assigned by the Board of Education
clauses.notes: Passive construction; implicit agent is the Board/District. Grants transportation entitlement to qualifying students.

clauses.quote: Any exception to the two-mile rule must be recommended by the Superintendent, approved by the Board of Education, and waived by the State Superintendent of Education.
clauses.subject_text: Any exception to the two-mile rule
clauses.notes: Procedural duty requiring multiple management-level approvals for routing exceptions.

clauses.quote: Special education students have the right to utilize regular school bus services unless individualized needs require other services.
clauses.notes: Extracted only the independent clause. Grants explicit right to special education students.

clauses.quote: Special Education transportation may be provided for students with disabilities based on unique needs of the student.
clauses.notes: Permissive clause granting management discretion to provide specialized transport based on individual needs.

clauses.quote: An Individualized Education Program (IEP) Committee will identify the unique needs and document the need for special school busltransportation services.
clauses.notes: Administrative duty for the IEP committee to assess and document transportation needs.

clauses.quote: Bus drivers must document misbehavior and report it to school principals.
clauses.notes: Duty imposed on district employees (bus drivers) to report student conduct issues.

clauses.quote: Principals are responsible for correcting misbehavior or problems that occur on school buses.
clauses.notes: Principals are classified as management; this assigns corrective duty to administration.
